localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple vertical and diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) that intersect the white pigmentation, primarily on the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; significant jagged irregularities and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated dark pigmentation circular cluster (focal spot) on the upper right lobe distal region.
